title: A bug lane proves every sibling call site of its defect
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-direction-1115k.md slice 3 (most valuable)
Why: clauses are written and proven by the worker itself, so on symptom-only rows a lane equals a plain session (K below 100% on 3 of 12, t-saj44em); a fix at one call site misses its siblings.
Outcome: for a bug task the precedent step greps the defect's pattern across other call sites and Stop demands one clause per hit: fixed, or stated not affected.
Files: src/brain/precedent.ts, src/brain/acceptance-clauses.ts, src/cli/lane-run/brief.ts, src/hook/stop.ts
Proof: the three K<100% rows in scripts/outside-hidden/discriminating-tasks.json reach hidden N/N.
Predicted: proof clauses-total >= 4
